g.text: Posting as Kape Isla · Edit business details
Submit it and an admin will check
One accent CTA per screen: "Post a job", "Save draft", "Submit for approval"
A draft can be saved with only a title; everything else is checked on submit (REQ-003-3, -6)
Salary is two whole-peso fields, monthly; there is no "negotiable" option (REQ-003-4)
Owner view: a status box on top, then the listing as visitors will see it
The status box changes with status: Waiting for approval → Withdraw; Needs changes → reason + Edit + Resubmit; Live → Close listing
Status labels: Draft, Waiting for approval, Live, Needs changes, Closed, Taken down — shown as a pill at the right of each row
